# ak command reference (appendix)

Generated from CLI **dev** (regenerate via `make skill-ref`).

This appendix is a **starting index** for the `ak-agentkit` CLI guide. The
`ak <cmd> --help` output and `--json` envelope are always authoritative.
If the version stamp above is older than `ak --version`, treat this file
as a hint and re-check flags via `ak <cmd> --help` before any mutating
call.

## Classification legend

- `read-only` — never mutates user, project, config or remote state, but may write disposable, reconstructible caches under AGENTKIT_HOME/cache
- `mutating` — installs, updates, removes, or writes durable state
- `diagnostic` — long-running or interactive (TUI, GUI, watch); user judgement is the main side effect
